calcTime.description:
Represents the start time of an execution of a {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job}. It is the reference time for which
the model health is to be calculated.
This field is dynamically populated during execution of {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job}.
If user needs to provide a `calcTime` for use cases such as reproducing results of prior execution,
it is recommended that users provide {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Context} for {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job#start}
with appropriate `calcTime`.

title:
Context for {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job} execution and consequently {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Operation}.
By default, this type only exposes a {@link #calcTime} that specifies the reference time for which the model health is to
be calculated.
If a developer wishes to add additional application-specific context, then they can extend this type and add additional
fields. After that, they need only pass this to their job and use the fields from within their implementation of
{@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Operation#calculateHealth}.
name: MlModel.HealthCalc.Context
